image_description: The image displays two white portable media players resting on a surface. The device on the right is a classic Apple iPod with a visible screen and click wheel. The device on the left is a similar rectangular media player but features significant visual anomalies: the screen displays garbled, nonsensical text and graphics that resemble alien script or melted pixels, and the control area below the screen has two irregular black smudges instead of a functional button interface. A human finger is partially visible holding the devices.
